description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_URIScheme_file, which models and validates the 'file://' URI scheme according to RFC standards. It includes properties indicating the accessibility of file URIs and a method to validate and sanitize URI components.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIScheme_file
classes.description: A class representing the 'file://' URI scheme with validation and accessibility properties.

methods.name: doValidate
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes the URI by resetting userinfo, port, and query components.
